name: AYRES, the Hon. Timothy (Tim)
research_notes: Initial pass 2026-09-16. All three frozen official occupation spells preserved. Party biography adds Riverina-to-Sydney transition in 2000; organiser spell remains one interval to avoid duplicate counting.

First speech establishes childhood fencing/cattle work and ACTU Organising Works cadetship. Neither is assigned paid/full-time status without evidence. Family-farm work is not automatically self-employment; participant in training is not automatically ACTU employee.

Unresolved gap: official secretary endpoint is 2017, Senate service starts 2019-07-01. AMWU successor announcement confirms departure after preselection but no exact cessation date or payroll status through 2019. Do not extend union employment to Senate entry or assume paid campaigning.

First speech's broad statement about 25 years of workplace experience does not identify employer-specific dates or FTE and cannot replace the 1996 official organiser start. Cadet date must not be inferred from the national program's 1994 inception.

Searches attempted: official/party/personal biography; first speech; AMWU successor and archives; 2017–2019 employment and annual-report searches; full-time and director searches. Namesake results for British artist/Canadian realtor excluded. Superannuation search results referring to other people not adopted.

Follow-up priority: ACTU cadet cohort and host union/payroll evidence, early jobs/university dates, AMWU annual officer returns and financial reports around 2017–2019, leave/cessation, ALP national-executive remuneration/dates and any paid governance roles. Last attempted 2026-09-16. Advance initial national pass before repeating queries.

Systematic follow-up2026-10-01: primary union filings add five external governance roles, personal remuneration and State Council cessation. Cbus annual report dates alternate appointment; McKell review documents departure. Original supported employment spells and null headlines preserved.

FWC2018/290 and2019/269 NSW financial reports searched for Ayres, no match; absence from those reports does not prove no continuing national employment.2017 report identifies other departing employees but not him in that table. Next lead is National Council payroll/annual returns and leave records across2017–2019, using State Council22September2017 as an office boundary only.

Earlier first-person Eveleigh account merits ACTU cohort/host-union follow-up; no calendar date inferred from age21, and broad years-of-experience statements do not prove continuous service. Cbus and Media Super-hosted archival PDFs intermittently returned404 on further extraction; indexed primary appointment/retirement passages preserved with limitation. MERT and ICN historical control, complete governance terms/remuneration, substantive hours and pre-1996 work remain unresolved. Last follow-up2026-10-01; advance in national plan order.

Second follow-up2026-10-02: national2017financialreport confirms NationalCouncil governance cessation22September2017, separate from previously recordedStateCouncil.2018nationalreporttext contains noAyresmatch; absence cannot establish unemployment, resignation payroll day or unpaid campaigning.2017/18rules direct employee externalboardfees to union, limiting assumptions about personal board income.

Nationalpayrollroute now checked for2017/18; no full personal employment register disclosed. Remaining leads are2019nationalofficer disclosures, individual appointment/leave evidence and ACTUcadethost history. No substantive full-time duration or zeroexperience conclusion justified.

Further2October follow-up: retrieved2019NationalCouncil report85pages, completing2017–19report route; no Ayres text match, and aggregate related-party/termination disclosures do not settle individual gap. AFR18March2026 profile https://www.afr.com/politics/federal/can-an-old-school-unionist-rebuild-australia-for-the-ai-era-20260318-p5po22 has a public snippet mentioning a cadet organiser in1995, but surrounding attribution is incomplete; direct open403Forbidden respected. Treat as chronology lead pending full context, not proven personal cadet start. Existing primary1995Eveleigh recollection retained. No material employment change or new total. Next require individual cadet-host record, public employment statement or accessible full-context profile; repeat national aggregate payroll searches now exhausted.

Follow-up 2026-10-04: targeted ACTU, AMWU and exact-name searches did not locate a cohort list, cadet host, appointment record or payroll evidence. Ayres' own profile repeats Organising Works enrolment and AMWU career sequence without dates; the AFR search excerpt still lacks enough surrounding attribution to promote 1995 as his cadet start. National aggregate filings remain exhausted. Retain the unresolved pre-1996 and 2017–19 gaps and advance without repeating them.
